event: Spinning, he steps down off the threshold into the cold and goes forward, all in.
The gold goes threadbare over wet, real stone, and the slope pulls him forward and down.
Warm, glad presences pass through his wheel unburnt; the pull to sit runs strongest one way.
He follows the lie downhill to where it is made; a gracious voice says sit, you've earned it.
He pours the core's last coal and his own deep well into one shaped, burning circle.

changes.note: The hottest and most careful fire he has ever released
The long spinning descent and the great turn

event: His fire passes through voice after voice, then lands and stays on one: real flesh.
Every warm thread runs back to the thing at the table's head, and he brings the wheel down.
The gold tears off the walls and the voices die: what is left is cold wet stone and old bone.

memory.fact: The Deep Den is the Host's cold stone predation-chamber, bare of any glamour.

event: The cracked thing does not fall: something lean, quick and cold gets up out of it and comes.
